name: io.github.emircbngl/blender-optics-simulator
description: Build, align & render a real optical bench in Blender; drivable by an AI agent over MCP.

environmentVariables.name: OPTICS_BRIDGE_PORT
environmentVariables.description: TCP port of the add-on's localhost bridge inside Blender (Optics > Simulation > Start MCP Bridge).

environmentVariables.name: OPTICS_BRIDGE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required capability token from Blender Add-on Preferences > MCP bridge.
